object.body:
Dear $__recipient.name,

The Just-In-Time duration window ${requestedForIdentityName} initiated for ${entitlementName} is now activated for ${activationDuration}.

Please contact ${ownerName} if you have any questions.


Thanks,
The $__global.productName Team
object.description: Notifies a manager, owner, or other interested party that a Just-In-Time activation window initiated by another identity is now active.
